Vikings Quarterback Kyler Murray Limited in Practice Due to Concussion

Minnesota Vikings quarterback Kyler Murray was limited in practice as he continues to recover from a concussion. This limited participation means backup quarterback Carson Wentz will start for the team. Running back Jordan Mason has been placed on the injured reserve list. The specific details of Murray's injury and recovery timeline were not provided.
